"""Camera/proprioception-only controller for the single live episode.
Commands and observations are retained in /app/output for the record.
"""
import os,json,time,traceback
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); n=0
out='/app/output'

def save(o):
 global obs,n,p,q
 obs=o;n+=1;o.save(f'{out}/obs{n:03d}')
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);q=p[4:11].copy()
 json.dump(o.meta,open(out+'/latest.json','w'))
 x=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
 for i,c in enumerate(cams):
  if c in o.last:
   im=Image.fromarray(o.last[c]);ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((4,4),c.replace('robot0_',''),fill='red');x.paste(im,((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
 x.save(out+'/views.png')
 print('obs',n,'eef',p[26:29].round(5),'q',q.round(4),'grip',p[11:13].round(4),'base',p[:4].round(4),'left',o.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)

def look():save(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none'))
def move(qt=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,steps=40):
 if qt is None:qt=q.copy()
 if grip is None:grip=p[36]
 A=np.zeros((steps,13));A[:,:7]=np.linspace(q,qt,steps);A[:,7]=grip;A[:,12]=-1
 if base is not None:A[:,8:11]=base;A[:,12]=1
 A[:,11]=torso
 save(r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none'))
def point(cam,u,v):
 c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];d=obs.depth[cam][-1] if obs.depth[cam].ndim==3 else obs.depth[cam]
 z=float(d[int(v),int(u)]);K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
 return (T@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1]))[:3]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for th,a,d,al in zip(q,[0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088],[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0],[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]):
  ca,sa=np.cos(al),np.sin(al);ct,st=np.cos(th),np.sin(th)
  T=T@np.array([[ct,-st,0,a],[st*ca,ct*ca,-sa,-sa*d],[st*sa,ct*sa,ca,ca*d],[0,0,0,1]])
 return T
look()
while True:
 if os.path.exists(out+'/command.py'):
  code=open(out+'/command.py').read();os.unlink(out+'/command.py')
  with open(out+'/commands.log','a') as f:f.write('\n'+code+'\n')
  try:exec(compile(code,'live-command','exec'),globals())
  except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
  open(out+'/done','w').write('done')
 time.sleep(.1)
